title: Forest Focus Session Focus Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forest:session focus_min=*
| stats sum(focus_min) as total_value, avg(focus_min) as avg_value by tree_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tree type values by total and average focus minutes across Forest focus session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `focus_min` values for each Forest focus session event and review total and average focus minutes by tree type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total focus minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It automatically which tree type shows the biggest focus minutes numbers in your Forest focus session data.
